title: Data-centric ultra-high-throughput experimentation enables AI-ready reaction-space mapping
author_line_verbatim: Lin Tan1, Majian Zeng1, Minghui Liang1, Qianghua Lin2, Yuefeng Wei1, Chan Zhu2, Yaxian Kong2, Kai Xue2, Kuangbiao Liao1*
version: 0612-corrected DOCX; corresponding 0612 PDF retains an acylation-CV discrepancy
public_status: Local unpublished/unverified-publication manuscript record; no public DOI established in this audit.
endpoint: Within-plate end-to-end yield repeatability of a single repeated reaction per class, 96 wells each; not low-yield analytical precision.
concentration_and_reaction_volume: Not specified for these three validation plates.
batch_information: One full 96-well plate is described per reaction class. Plate identifiers, dates and independent day/batch replicate counts are not supplied for these tables.
analytical_method_scope: The general platform workflow is DESI-TOF-MS triage, selected UPLC-UV/MS and selected 1H NMR calibration. Tables S8-S10 label values Yield; their individual well-level measurement tier is not specified.
statistics_convention: Recalculated from 96 published integer-percentage entries in each source table. Sample CV = stdev(ddof=1)/mean*100; population CV also supplied. Original unrounded measurements are not present in these tables.
